Vaibhav Suryavanshi's Explosive Innings Leads India A to Tri-Series Title

Fifteen-year-old Vaibhav Suryavanshi played a crucial role in India A's victory in the Tri-Series final against Sri Lanka A. His rapid scoring, including a fifty off 11 balls, helped secure the championship. Suryavanshi's performance has drawn attention, with discussions around his future international prospects.
